name: Tankle
author: Milky Natas
description: A top-down tank battle: take on the enemy tanks on the field, with stats for speed, shot trajectory and cooldown shown next to your level.

descriptions.en: A top-down tank battle: take on the enemy tanks on the field, with stats for speed, shot trajectory and cooldown shown next to your level.
descriptions.it: Battaglia di carri armati vista dall'alto: affronta i carri nemici sul campo, con statistiche di velocità, traiettoria e ricarica accanto al tuo livello.
